name: MTR Puliogare Paste
ingredients: Refined palmolein oil, Mixed spices, Tamarind concentrate (13%), Sugar, lodised salt, Peanut (5.8%), Coconut products (2.6%) [Dry coconut (Copra) & Desiccated coconut), Curry Leaves (Fresh leaves & Dry powder), Black sesame (1.8%), Jaggery (1.4%), Black gram splits, Bengal gram splits, Acidity regulators (INS 260 & INS 334) and Preservative (INS 210). Allergen Advice: Contains Nut. May contains Milk.
